newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares up on week in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares up on week in Beirut.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose in the week ended on Thursday on the Beirut Stock exchange on a bloc order.
Financial markets will close on Friday for the All Saints Day holiday.
A shares rose to $114 from last Friday's $113 and B shares were also up to $117.875 from $117.125.
Weekly turnover in SOLIDERE shares was 35,549 shares from 38,636 last week, and value was $4,079,534 from $4,352,955.125.
Also traded, for the first time in three weeks, was a bloc of 108,235 shares of Ciments Libanais at $1.27.
There was no trade for the third successive week in the three other listed companies: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.23 percent to 84.60 on the week and the BLOM stock index rose 0.60 percent to 985.27.
